not_computable.accepts, rejects, false accepts and fals: summary.json carries the four counts only as run totals; by class it carries claims, automated decisions, wrong automated decisions (false accepts and false rejects together), human reviews, confirmed records, units and days to confirmation. The split by class and error direction exists only in the event journal, which is not downloaded.
not_computable.organisational verification hours and co: no cumulative daily column exists for them; they are reported for the whole run (the shared history is identical in every arm).

note: ci95 is a Student-t interval over worlds; null when fewer than two worlds or zero SD. P1 to P4 carry Holm-adjusted p for the primary outcome; every other p-value is unadjusted.

scope.complete_means: all 7 pre-specified arms have a verified day-2191 checkpoint (four-year analysis; not the planned five-year run)

half_width_factor.formula: t(0.975, n-1)/sqrt(n); 95% half-width = factor x SD of the paired differences

scope.note: started minus complete minus stopped = 0; a non-zero value means worlds that are neither stopped nor complete
scope.text: 4 of 10 planned firms reached the four-year horizon in all arms. The loss of precision: the 95% half-width is 1.591 SD for the 4 accepted firms, against 0.925 for seven and 0.715 for ten firms, so a given spread of the paired differences gives intervals 2.22 times as wide as ten firms would.
scope.worlds_started_source: --started (prespecification, fifth note: ten planned, seven started)

sentences.attribution: The sandbox architecture raises the net operating result inside a hierarchy (S4); a gain that appears there is attributed to automation with scoped authority, which is available under any authority rule.
sentences.break_even_p1: Sandbox DAMS has a higher mean net operating result than the Hierarchy at the declared rate; the difference vanishes at a processing rate of 1.23.
sentences.break_even_p2: Sandbox DAMS has a higher mean net operating result than the Automated hierarchy at the declared rate; the difference vanishes at a processing rate of 2.76.
sentences.break_even_s3: The mean net operating result of Sandbox DAMS is lower than that of the Sandbox hierarchy at the declared rate, and a higher rate lowers it further relative to the Sandbox hierarchy.
sentences.level_order: From the highest to the lowest mean net operating result the arms are Sandbox hierarchy; Sandbox DAMS, central record; Sandbox DAMS; Automated hierarchy; Automated DAMS; Hierarchy; and Manual DAMS.
sentences.note: LaTeX-ready sentences (percent signs and minus signs already escaped); the unfunded and proposition sentences are built in make_tex.py
sentences.p_three: The margin of 2\% of the Hierarchy mean is 13.83 units. For P3, the 95\% interval lies wholly inside $\pm$2\% of the Hierarchy mean, so the authority rule makes no material operating difference in this model.
sentences.p_two: The interval of P2 lies above zero: the complete design has an operating advantage over a hierarchy with the same automation in this model.
sentences.precision: With four firms the 95\% half-width of an interval is 1.591 times the standard deviation of the paired differences, against 0.715 with ten firms; the intervals are 122\% wider than the design of ten firms would give.
sentences.scope: Of the ten planned firms, four reached the four-year horizon in all seven arms.

unfunded_check.basis: increase of operating_unfunded_resource_units_cumulative from the branch day on, per post member-year
unfunded_check.column_contains: the part of the daily operating bill that cash could not cover (payroll, maintenance, dual-running, infrastructure maintenance, legal and interest costs; LongitudinalEngine._step lines 818-829) plus the part of the end-of-day processing charge that cash could not cover (lines 1087-1092); it is not split by cause in the output files, so it is an upper bound on the unpaid processing charge
unfunded_check.text: The unfunded operating amount is zero after adoption in every accepted firm and arm: the processing charge, in the arms that pay one, was paid in full, so the net operating result of every arm is net of all processing cost.
